sentences.text: When the matter was taken up for hearing today, learned counsel for the petitioner produced the order passed in WP.No.3057 of 2022 dated 18.02.2022, pursuant to which proceedings were initiated by the RDO, Tambaram dated 22.01.2023.
The learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is also similarly placed and hence, he is entitled for the very same benefit that was given to one M.Parameswari.
The learned Additional Government Pleader seeks for sometime to take instructions in this regard.
2.Post this case under the caption 'for orders' on 20.02.2025.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

4.When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of National Highways Department submitted that pursuant to the order passed in W.P.No.3057 of 2022, dated 18.02.2022, a private negotiation was entered into with the petitioner in that writ petition and a Sale Deed was also executed dated 12.07.2023 which was registered as Document No.6202 of 2023.
A copy of the document was also placed before this Court.

5.It was also brought to the notice of this Court that the case of the petitioner will also be dealt with in the same manner and that the earlier order passed in W.P.No.3057 of 2022 dated 18.02.2022 will enure in favour of the petitioner also.

6.In the light of the above submission and after considering the materials placed before this Court,
there shall be a direction to the petitioner to submit a fresh representation before the Special District Revenue Officer (Land Acquisition), National Highways Project, Chengalpattu.
